articles.summary: MONDOVI, Wis., June 15, 2017 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Marten Transport, Ltd. (Nasdaq/GS:MRTN) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a five-for-three stock split of the company’s common stock. The stock split will be effected in the form of a stock dividend payable on July 7, 2017, to stockholders of record as of June…
articles.title: MARTEN TRANSPORT ANNOUNCES FIVE-FOR-THREE STOCK SPLIT
